expectations.text: Names the book's nine models (map/territory, circle of competence, first principles, thought experiment, second-order, probabilistic, inversion, Occam's razor, Hanlon's razor)
Applies first principles with Socratic questioning and/or Five Whys
Applies second-order thinking (consequences of consequences) to the decision
Applies inversion (what would make it fail / what to avoid)
Applies probabilistic thinking with base rates/Bayesian updating
Applies circle of competence with the operate-outside advice (learn basics, consult experts)
